licence_file: License.txt inside the pack; the line above is its licence text

assembly.grid: 1 kit cell = 1 world unit; footprint x and y in [0, 2] and [0, 2], floor at z 0, wall panel 1 unit high
assembly.orientation: door on the south face, camera at the south-east corner; the building itself does not rotate
pieces_finished: wall-wood x4, wall-wood-window-small x1, wall-wood-doorway-square-wide x1, wall-window-shutters x2 (shopfront and walls)
chimney x1, chimney-top x1 (breaks the roof line)
pieces_half_built: poles x3 (scaffold on the open east and north sides)

render.yaw_used: 135 deg = one yaw 45 deg off the S axis (camera at the building's south-east corner, south and east faces visible); buildings do not rotate
render.material_override: roof pieces use one flat #A33B2E material; the farm plot uses one flat #8A6A43 material; every other kit material is as authored

scale.why: 2x2 shop at native scale: wide doorway, shuttered windows, a chimney above the roof apex and a bench at the front. The factor is 1.00 against the 50.6 px per kit cell that content/kam2/house/source.json records as native, so every kind shares one honest scale.

pivot.meaning: footprint centre on the ground plane; the cell x differs from 112 only because the model's alpha box is asymmetric (props on one side), the pivot itself is the footprint centre

atlas.rows_note: row 0 finished, row 1 half_built; one facing each, buildings do not rotate
atlas.pack_command: node tools/kam2/pack_atlas.mjs --in <frames> --out content/kam2/buildings/bakery --id house.bakery --kind building --facings 1 --anim finished:1:8:true --anim half_built:1:8:true --footprint 2x2

states.damaged: not rendered: the sim has no damaged house state (House has no hit points); a broken variant would need its own assembly per kind

notes: The kit is CC0 and is never committed; only this rendered atlas and its settings are.
The kit has no crate, bale, field or crop piece. The warehouse uses a loaded cart as the goods stand-in; the farm uses low hedge pieces as crop rows on a dirt-coloured plank plot.
Roof pieces carry one flat #A33B2E material; every other kit material is as authored. The farm plot planks carry one flat #8A6A43 material.
States are atlas rows of one id, finished then half_built. The sim has no damaged house state, so no damaged row is shipped: a broken model per kind is a different assembly, not a tint.
No team-colour mask and no cameo pass yet; both manifest fields stay null.
Half-built and finished share one cell, span and pivot, so the two rows stack without a jump.
fps 8 and loop true on each state row are placeholders the packer needs; both states are stills.
